name: paper-motivator
description: Add motivating real-world news and business cases to a Beamer slide deck. Use this skill whenever the user wants to strengthen slides with current events, named-firm examples, industry anecdotes, or policy relevance for a research presentation. Trigger on phrases like "add motivation to my slides", "find news for my talk", "business cases for my presentation", "make my slides more compelling", "real-world examples for Beamer", or any request to connect research findings to current events or corporate announcements. This skill reads the LaTeX deck, extracts key slide messages, searches for aligned news and named-firm cases in parallel, and writes a slide-ready motivation supplement.
